editorial:
If you want a loud, fast action movie with jokes and explosions, this one delivers. A tech billionaire fakes his death, builds a secret team of specialists, and goes after a cruel dictator. The story is simple, but the energy is huge. Ryan Reynolds leads with his usual quick humor, and the team feels like a rough but fun group of ghosts. You get car chases, big stunts, and a globe-trotting vibe that rarely slows down.

The action is the main draw, with huge set pieces and a bright, glossy look. The downside is that the plot can feel thin, and the camera work gets messy during fights. Still, if you want pure popcorn entertainment, it works well. Action fans will have the most fun, while viewers wanting deep characters may want more.
endingExplained: By the end, the team breaks into the dictator's palace during a public event, fights through his guards, and captures him. They expose his crimes, clear the way for his brother to take power, and fake their own deaths again. The final twist is that they are still ghosts, free to choose their next target while the world thinks they are gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big action and quick humor.
